description: Source code implementing the LinuxCoreDumper class for handling Linux core dump files in the Google Breakpad crash reporting system.

classes.name: LinuxCoreDumper
classes.description: Class responsible for creating core dumps on Linux systems, parsing core dump files, and extracting thread information.

methods.name: BuildProcPath
methods.description: Constructs a file path within the /proc filesystem for a given process ID and node.

methods.name: CopyFromProcess
methods.description: Copies data from a process's memory space into the core dump, handling address translation.

methods.name: GetThreadInfoByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves thread information at a specified index from the internal thread list.

methods.name: IsPostMortem
methods.description: Indicates that this dumper operates after process termination.

methods.name: ThreadsSuspend
methods.description: Stub indicating thread suspension is not performed.

methods.name: ThreadsResume
methods.description: Stub indicating thread resumption is not performed.

methods.name: EnumerateThreads
methods.description: Parses the core dump to enumerate all threads and extract their register states.
